title: Contract-event records (0x0008) version 8: the board's availability events
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/contract-event-v8-vectors.py: an independent Python implementation of docs/spec/contracts.md (Contract-event record, Event tables (version 8)) over contract-event-v7-vectors.py's version-7 check and availability-vectors.py's strict decoding and signing of availability records; records from availability.json, a root from delivery-root.json, a ballot from ballot.json, and every record of contract-event-v7.json re-checked
